title: Among the patients who has a normal level of anti-centromere and a normal l
question:
Among the patients who has a normal level of anti-centromere and a normal level of anti-SSB, how many of them are male?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: normal level of anti-centromere refers to CENTROMEA IN('-', '+-'); normal level of anti-SSB refers to SSB IN('-', '+-'); male refers to Sex = 'M'; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE
  l.XCL_041 = 'normal'
  AND l.XCL_045 = 'normal'
  AND p.XCL_063 = 'M'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_058)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
WHERE l.XCL_055 IN ('-', '+-')
  AND l.XCL_054 IN ('-', '+-')
  AND p.XCL_059 = 'M'
